## Measure, decidí, optimize.

- Measure apple size with your smartphone.
- Analyse single or multiple fruits in the same image.
- Replace manual measurements with an automated, AI-based approach.
- Get instant results to optimize agronomic management decisions (thinning, irrigation, or fertilization).
- Use a simple and fast tool designed for real-field conditions.

:::
:::

## Why is it useful?

- Reduce manual measurement errors and variability.
- Save time and labour in field workflows.
- Support data-driven agricultural management decisions (thinning, irrigation, and fertilization).
- Accelerate the digitalization of agriculture and the adoption of precision agriculture tools.

:::
